clips.title: The story
paras: The Snufflenose Command Stick is a training rod provided by the goblin entrepreneur Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. It is used to direct trained snufflenose gophers to locate and unearth valuable blueleaf tubers buried deep within Razorfen Kraul.

Blueleaf tubers are coveted delicacies across Azeroth, but finding them is nearly impossible without specialized help. Buried in the thorny underground depths of Razorfen Kraul, the roots are entirely hidden from sight. To exploit this lucrative market without braving the quilboar dens himself, the Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix conditioned keen-scented snufflenose gophers to dig up the tubers. The Snufflenose Command Stick is the tool adventurers use to direct these trained critters, prodding them to sniff out and expose root nodes from up to fifty paces away.
